text: # Synthetic operational record N13 [N13-01] Release N13-R1 occurred on 19 September 2034 at 10:00 under revision B. Ada signed as north-operator while that alias mapped to P-AQ; her credential was active. Cora issued signed approval N13-A1 at 09:00 that day. Permit N13-P1 covered the full day and was unrevoked at release. Permit and approval histories are complete for the named interval. The signed handoff identifies the same node, preventing use of another node's permit. No exception is needed for this ordinary release. [N13-02] Bundle receipt. This node belongs to rack 2, monitoring segment S1. The named handoff transferred configuration bundle sequence 1013, checksum label L3013, to node N13. The receipt confirms bundle identity and administrative handoff, not all future service behavior. It does not independently establish complete event history outside the stated interval.
